  IMultiFn
  (-reset [mf]
    (set! method-table (.-EMPTY PersistentHashMap))
    (set! method-cache method-table)
    (set! prefer-table (.-EMPTY PersistentHashMap))
    (set! cached-hierarchy nil)
    mf)

  (-add-method [mf dispatch-val method]
    (set! method-table (assoc method-table dispatch-val method))
    (set! method-cache method-table)
    (set! cached-hierarchy @hierarchy)
    mf)

  (-remove-method [mf dispatch-val]
    (set! method-table (dissoc method-table dispatch-val))
    (set! method-cache method-table)
    (set! cached-hierarchy @hierarchy)
    mf)

  (-get-method [mf dispatch-val]
    (when-not (identical? cached-hierarchy @hierarchy)
      (set! method-cache method-table)
      (set! cached-hierarchy @hierarchy))
    (let [target-fn (get method-cache dispatch-val)]
      (if (nil? target-fn)
        (loop []
          (let [mt method-table
                pt prefer-table
                ch cached-hierarchy
                best (find-and-cache-best-method name dispatch-val ch mt pt default-dispatch-val)]
            (cond
              (nil? best) nil
              (and (identical? mt method-table) (identical? pt prefer-table)
                   (identical? ch cached-hierarchy) (identical? cached-hierarchy @hierarchy))
              (do (set! method-cache (assoc method-cache dispatch-val best))
                  best)
              :else (do (set! method-cache method-table)
                        (set! cached-hierarchy @hierarchy)
                        (recur)))))
        target-fn)))

  (-prefer-method [mf dispatch-val-x dispatch-val-y]
    (when (prefers* @hierarchy dispatch-val-y dispatch-val-x prefer-table)
      (let [fmt (fn [v] (if (nil? v) "null" (str v)))]
        (throw (suss.bootstrap/error
                 (str "Preference conflict in multimethod '" name "': " (fmt dispatch-val-y)
                      " is already preferred to " (fmt dispatch-val-x))))))
    (set! prefer-table
          (assoc prefer-table dispatch-val-x
                 (conj (get prefer-table dispatch-val-x (.-EMPTY PersistentHashSet))
                       dispatch-val-y)))
    (set! method-cache method-table)
    (set! cached-hierarchy @hierarchy)
    mf)

  (-methods [mf] method-table)
  (-prefers [mf] prefer-table)
  (-default-dispatch-val [mf] default-dispatch-val)
  (-dispatch-fn [mf] dispatch-fn)

  IHash
  (-hash [this] (suss.bootstrap/identity-uid this)))
rationale: Follows Clojure's MultiFn.java (#30). The tables are mutable fields, as Clojure's are volatile fields, not atoms, and start as empty hash maps, so methods and prefers return hash maps as Clojure's do. -get-method resets the cache when the hierarchy is no longer identical to the one cached (ClojureScript compares with =), and caches a found method only if the tables and hierarchy are unchanged, else it redoes the search. -prefer-method checks for a conflict in the multimethod's hierarchy and returns the multimethod (ClojureScript returns the reset hierarchy). The IFn stanza is unchanged. INamed is dropped, as Clojure's MultiFn is not Named; identity hashing is kept. Messages are Clojure's, with each dispatch value formatted as String.format's %s formats it: with str, and "null" for nil.
